T: One last ride. One good dinner.
D: An ageing Logan cares for a frail Charles Xavier and protects a young girl being hunted.
P: Serve the mains when the Munson family invite them in for dinner.
S: the hideout near the Mexican border
Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.
Beef jerky, salted peanuts, corn chips and a big bag of mixed lollies tipped into a bowl, the kind of thing you'd grab from a servo counter.
the corn growing on the Munson farm
Fresh corn cut off the cob folded into a batter of flour, egg, milk, spring onion and chilli, fried in spoonfuls until golden. Sour cream.
M: the one good dinner the Munsons share
Pan-fried pork chops with apple and onion gravy, mashed potato and green beans. Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side.
the casino hotel where they stop for a night
Rib eye dry-brined, seared hard in a smoking pan, butter basted, pulled at 54C and rested, with a baked potato split and loaded with sour cream, chives and cracked pepper.
W: Peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and cornflour in a lattice pie, baked at 190C for 50 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: the bottle Logan always has close
60ml bourbon poured neat into a heavy glass, a single ice cube if the day was long.

s.note: the hideout near the Mexican border
s.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with 3 soaked dried chillies, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours until it shreds. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and lime.

s.note: the corn growing on the Munson farm
s.how: Cut the kernels off 3 corn cobs. Whisk 120g flour, 2 eggs and 125ml milk, then fold in the corn, 2 spring onions and a chopped chilli. Fry spoonfuls until golden and serve with sour cream.

m.note: the one good dinner the Munsons share
m.how: Season 4 pork chops and pan-fry 4 minutes a side. Fry 1 sliced onion and 1 sliced apple in the pan, add 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp mustard and reduce. Serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter and 300g steamed green beans.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 100g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tbsp cornflour. Line a dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve with ice cream.

d.note: the bottle Logan always has close
d.how: Pour 60ml bourbon neat into each of four heavy glasses. Add a single ice cube to any glass where the day was long. Drink it slowly on the porch.
